hypotheses.title: Batch 68: Decorrelated Grand Slam Breakout (Targeting 4th Daily Approved Alpha)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Pivots the verified high-performance Card 4 engine (Sharpe 1.84, Fitness 1.58) and unmined long-term options datasets across decorrelated universes and neutralizations to overcome the self-correlation ceiling (< 0.70): (1) Consensus Net Income Yield + 5-Day VWAP Reversion in TOP2000 (Industry Neutral): Eliminates market-wide factor overlap with Alpha 19 by scoping to TOP2000 with intra-industry ranking. (2) Consensus Net Income Yield + 5-Day VWAP Reversion in TOP1000 (Sector Neutral): Captures pure large-cap earnings dislocation. (3) 3-Year LEAP Put IV (1080d) + Quarterly Audited FX Hedging in TOP1000 (Sector Neutral): Direct counterpart to Alpha 22 (Fitness 1.85 EXCELLENT), capturing multi-year institutional crash hedging premia with zero self-correlation. (4) Operating Income Yield + 5-Day VWAP Reversion in TOP2000 (Industry Neutral): Tests cash-flow operating yield within mid-to-large-cap industries.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if mid-cap earnings revisions align identically with broad-market index beta during quarterly earnings cycles.
